title: Identification of Terpenoid Chemotypes Among High (-)-trans-Delta9-Tetrahydrocannabinol-Producing Cannabis sativa L. Cultivars
note: Peer-reviewed terpene study including samples labeled OG Kush. The OG Kush group was characterized primarily by myrcene with similar or somewhat lower limonene, while beta-caryophyllene and related terpenoids also contributed to the group profile. Cultivar-name identity limitations remain.
